entities.name: 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security parameters for authentication, integrity protection and ciphering tied together and identified by ngKSI. Can be native or mapped type.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key set identifier consisting of value and security context type parameter indicating native or mapped 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF to take 5G NAS security context into use for secure NAS message exchange.

entities.name: Primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Procedure between AMF and UE that creates a 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: Inter-system change procedure
entities.description: Procedure for changing between S1 mode and N1 mode, which may create mapped 5G NAS security contexts.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: 5G mobility management registered state where security contexts are active.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5G mobility management deregistered state where security contexts may be marked invalid.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message that contains ngKSI IE indicating current 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message that contains ngKSI IE and is used to take security context into use.

entities.name: ngKSI deletion condition
entities.description: Condition where UE sets ngKSI to 'no key is available' and considers associated keys invalid.

relations.description: 5G NAS security context is identified by ngKSI.
Security mode control procedure takes 5G NAS security context into use.
Primary authentication creates 5G NAS security context.
Inter-system change may create mapped 5G NAS security context.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains ngKSI IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains ngKSI IE.
Condition triggers ngKSI deletion and key invalidation.
Security context handling depends on 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
5G NAS security context provides integrity protection for REGISTRATION REQUEST.
5G NAS security context provides integrity protection for SECURITY MODE COMMAND.
